title: 〜直す / 〜なおす
meaning: re-do… / do… again to fix or improve it
simpleExplanation: Verb stem + 直す means "do it again, this time properly": 書き直す "rewrite", やり直す "redo", 考え直す "rethink", かけ直す "call back". The key idea is fixing or improving, not simply repeating.
whenUsed: Daily conversation, work and school (レポートを書き直す, 電話をかけ直す), and reflection (人生をやり直す). Extremely common; also used politely on the phone: 後でかけ直します.
formation: Verb ます-stem + 直す (Group 1 verb: 直した, 直して, 直します)
Common: 書き直す, やり直す, 考え直す, 見直す, かけ直す, 作り直す, 出直す, 読み直す

steps.en: there are many mistakes (a problem is found)
rewrite the report to fix it (直す = do over, better)

examples.ja: 間違いが多いので、もう一度書き直した。
examples.reading: まちがいがおおいので、もういちどかきなおした。
examples.en: There were many mistakes, so I rewrote it.

examples.ja: 電話が切れたので、かけ直します。
examples.reading: でんわがきれたので、かけなおします。
examples.en: The call was cut off, so I'll call back.
examples.note: かけ直す = call back after a cut-off; a set phone phrase.

examples.ja: 計画を最初から考え直そう。
examples.reading: けいかくをさいしょからかんがえなおそう。
examples.en: Let's rethink the plan from the beginning.
examples.note: 考え直す = rethink from scratch.

examples.ja: 計算が合わないので、もう一度見直してみます。
examples.reading: けいさんがあわないので、もういちどみなおしてみます。
examples.en: The figures don't add up, so I'll go over them again.
examples.note: 見直す = check again to correct.

examples.ja: 失敗しても、何度でもやり直せばいい。
examples.reading: しっぱいしても、なんどでもやりなおせばいい。
examples.en: Even if you fail, you can just start over as many times as you need.
examples.note: やり直す = start over; potential form やり直せる.

similarGrammar.difference: Just 'do it once more', no implication of fixing. 直す implies improvement.
Repeating in the opposite direction or many times (読み返す = read again, 繰り返す = repeat). Not about correcting.
'Repair, fix' something concrete: 時計を直す. The compound adds the idea to another action.

commonMistakes.why: 直す attaches to the ます-stem.

commonMistakes.wrong: 同じ映画をもう一度見直した。(meaning 'watched again for fun')
commonMistakes.right: 同じ映画をもう一度見た。
commonMistakes.why: 見直す means 'review / re-examine' (or 'see in a new light'); for casual re-watching just use もう一度見る.

commonMistakes.wrong: 電話をかけ直します。(said when calling back is not yet needed)
commonMistakes.why: Not a grammar error, but note かけ直す presupposes an earlier failed or interrupted call.

usageNotes: 見直す has a second meaning: 'reassess someone favourably' (彼を見直した = I think better of him now).
出直す means 'come back another time' (出直してきます).
The noun form 〜直し appears in やり直し 'a do-over'.
jlptTips: If the sentence mentions a mistake, a cut-off or a change of plan, choose 直す.
Compare with 込む, 切る, 抜く, かける in the same question set: 直す is the only one meaning 'again'.
見直す may be tested with its 'reassess' meaning in reading passages.
